description: Re-running the AIM33 vs PGA3/NQR1 and cb5r reference alignments from UniProt, tabulating the cofactor-site residues and plotting windowed identity
code:
# AIM33 (Q04516) vs its WGD ohnolog PGA3/NQR1 (Q12746) and the cb5r references.
# Fully self-contained: fetches sequences from UniProt, re-runs Needleman-Wunsch
# with hardcoded BLOSUM62, reports windowed identity and the cofactor-site residues.
import requests, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

AAs = "ARNDCQEGHILKMFPSTWYV"
B62 = """ 4 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -1  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  0 -3 -2  0
-1  5  0 -2 -3  1  0 -2  0 -3 -2  2 -1 -3 -2 -1 -1 -3 -2 -3
-2  0  6  1 -3  0  0  0  1 -3 -3  0 -2 -3 -2  1  0 -4 -2 -3
-2 -2  1  6 -3  0  2 -1 -1 -3 -4 -1 -3 -3 -1  0 -1 -4 -3 -3
 0 -3 -3 -3  9 -3 -4 -3 -3 -1 -1 -3 -1 -2 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1
-1  1  0  0 -3  5  2 -2  0 -3 -2  1  0 -3 -1  0 -1 -2 -1 -2
-1  0  0  2 -4  2  5 -2  0 -3 -3  1 -2 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -2  0 -1 -3 -2 -2  6 -2 -4 -4 -2 -3 -3 -2  0 -2 -2 -3 -3
-2  0  1 -1 -3  0  0 -2  8 -3 -3 -1 -2 -1 -2 -1 -2 -2  2 -3
-1 -3 -3 -3 -1 -3 -3 -4 -3  4  2 -3  1  0 -3 -2 -1 -3 -1  3
-1 -2 -3 -4 -1 -2 -3 -4 -3  2  4 -2  2  0 -3 -2 -1 -2 -1  1
-1  2  0 -1 -3  1  1 -2 -1 -3 -2  5 -1 -3 -1  0 -1 -3 -2 -2
-1 -1 -2 -3 -1  0 -2 -3 -2  1  2 -1  5  0 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1  1
-2 -3 -3 -3 -2 -3 -3 -3 -1  0  0 -3  0  6 -4 -2 -2  1  3 -1
-1 -2 -2 -1 -3 -1 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3 -1 -2 -4  7 -1 -1 -4 -3 -2
 1 -1  1  0 -1  0  0  0 -1 -2 -2  0 -1 -2 -1  4  1 -3 -2 -2
 0 -1  0 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -2 -1 -1 -1 -1 -2 -1  1  5 -2 -2  0
-3 -3 -4 -4 -2 -2 -3 -2 -2 -3 -2 -3 -1  1 -4 -3 -2 11  2 -3
-2 -2 -2 -3 -2 -1 -2 -3  2 -1 -1 -2 -1  3 -3 -2 -2  2  7 -1
 0 -3 -3 -3 -1 -2 -2 -3 -3  3  1 -2  1 -1 -2 -2  0 -3 -1  4"""
M = np.array([[int(x) for x in r.split()] for r in B62.strip().split("\n")], float)
idx = {a: i for i, a in enumerate(AAs)}

def fetch(ac):
    r = requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{ac}.fasta", timeout=60)
    r.raise_for_status()
    return "".join(r.text.split("\n")[1:]).strip()

def nw(s1, s2, go=-11.0, ge=-1.0):
    n, m = len(s1), len(s2)
    a = np.array([idx.get(c, -1) for c in s1]); b = np.array([idx.get(c, -1) for c in s2])
    Sub = np.where((a[:, None] >= 0) & (b[None, :] >= 0),
                   M[np.clip(a, 0, 19)[:, None], np.clip(b, 0, 19)[None, :]], -1.0)
    NEG = -1e9
    Mm = np.full((n+1, m+1), NEG); Ix = np.full((n+1, m+1), NEG); Iy = np.full((n+1, m+1), NEG)
    Pm = np.zeros((n+1, m+1), np.int8); Px = np.zeros((n+1, m+1), np.int8); Py = np.zeros((n+1, m+1), np.int8)
    Mm[0, 0] = 0.0
    Ix[1:, 0] = 0.0; Iy[0, 1:] = 0.0          # free end gaps
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        for j in range(1, m+1):
            best = max(Mm[i-1, j-1], Ix[i-1, j-1], Iy[i-1, j-1])
            Pm[i, j] = int(np.argmax([Mm[i-1, j-1], Ix[i-1, j-1], Iy[i-1, j-1]]))
            Mm[i, j] = best + Sub[i-1, j-1]
            ox = [Mm[i-1, j] + go, Ix[i-1, j] + ge]
            Px[i, j] = int(np.argmax(ox)); Ix[i, j] = max(ox)
            oy = [Mm[i, j-1] + go, Iy[i, j-1] + ge]
            Py[i, j] = int(np.argmax(oy)); Iy[i, j] = max(oy)
    # free end gaps: start from best cell in last row/col
    i, j = n, m
    st = int(np.argmax([Mm[n, m], Ix[n, m], Iy[n, m]]))
    al1, al2 = [], []
    while i > 0 and j > 0:
        if st == 0:
            al1.append(s1[i-1]); al2.append(s2[j-1]); st = Pm[i, j]; i -= 1; j -= 1
        elif st == 1:
            al1.append(s1[i-1]); al2.append("-"); st = Px[i, j]; i -= 1
        else:
            al1.append("-"); al2.append(s2[j-1]); st = Py[i, j]; j -= 1
    while i > 0: al1.append(s1[i-1]); al2.append("-"); i -= 1
    while j > 0: al1.append("-"); al2.append(s2[j-1]); j -= 1
    return "".join(al1[::-1]), "".join(al2[::-1])

seq = {ac: fetch(ac) for ac in ["Q04516", "Q12746", "P00387", "P20070", "P38626"]}
names = {"Q04516": "AIM33", "Q12746": "PGA3/NQR1", "P00387": "hCYB5R3", "P20070": "ratCYB5R3", "P38626": "Cbr1"}
for ac, s in seq.items():
    print(f"{names[ac]:10s} {ac} len={len(s)}")

A = seq["Q04516"]
POS = {"R122": 122, "Y124": 124, "G185": 185, "G186": 186, "G188": 188, "P191": 191,
       "E216": 216, "H244": 244, "Y256": 256, "C278": 278, "F312": 312}

rows = {}
for ac in ["Q12746", "P00387", "P20070", "P38626"]:
    a1, a2 = nw(A, seq[ac])
    # map AIM33 numbering -> partner residue
    i = j = 0; mp = {}
    ident = tot = 0
    for c1, c2 in zip(a1, a2):
        if c1 != "-": i += 1
        if c2 != "-": j += 1
        if c1 != "-" and c2 != "-":
            mp[i] = (j, c2); tot += 1
            if c1 == c2: ident += 1
    rows[ac] = (mp, ident, tot)
    print(f"AIM33 vs {names[ac]:10s}: identity {100*ident/tot:5.1f}% over {tot} aligned columns")

print()
hdr = f"{'AIM33':>8s} | " + " | ".join(f"{names[ac]:>12s}" for ac in rows)
print(hdr); print("-"*len(hdr))
for lab, p in POS.items():
    cells = []
    for ac in rows:
        mp = rows[ac][0]
        cells.append(f"{mp[p][1]}{mp[p][0]}" if p in mp else "-")
    print(f"{lab:>8s} | " + " | ".join(f"{c:>12s}" for c in cells))

# windowed identity AIM33 vs PGA3
a1, a2 = nw(A, seq["Q12746"])
i = 0; per = np.full(len(A), np.nan)
for c1, c2 in zip(a1, a2):
    if c1 != "-":
        i += 1
        per[i-1] = 1.0 if c1 == c2 else 0.0
W = 25
win = np.array([np.nanmean(per[max(0, k-W//2):k+W//2+1]) for k in range(len(A))])
nt = np.nanmean(per[:65]); cat = np.nanmean(per[69:312])
print(f"\nAIM33 vs PGA3 identity: N-term 1-65 = {100*nt:.0f}%, catalytic 70-312 = {100*cat:.0f}%, overall = {100*np.nanmean(per):.1f}%")

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(11, 4.2))
ax.plot(np.arange(1, len(A)+1), 100*win, color="#1f4e79", lw=1.8)
ax.axvspan(1, 65, color="#f2c0c0", alpha=.6)
ax.text(33, 95, f"N-terminal anchor\n{100*nt:.0f}% identity", ha="center", fontsize=9)
ax.text(190, 95, f"catalytic domain\n{100*cat:.0f}% identity", ha="center", fontsize=9)
for lab, p in POS.items():
    col = "#c00000" if lab in ("E216", "H244", "Y256") else "#777777"
    ax.axvline(p, color=col, lw=1.0, ls="--", alpha=.8)
    ax.text(p, -9, lab, rotation=90, ha="center", va="top", fontsize=7, color=col)
ax.set_xlim(1, len(A)); ax.set_ylim(0, 105)
ax.set_xlabel("AIM33 (Q04516) residue"); ax.set_ylabel("identity to PGA3, 25-residue window (%)")
ax.set_title("AIM33 and its ohnolog PGA3/NQR1 share the catalytic core and the whole cofactor site,\nand diverge only in the N-terminal membrane anchor", fontsize=10)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
